name: Monk
description:
The Monk MCP server enables AI assistants to connect directly to your Monk instance to get work done with natural language – checking balances, verifying collections, and more. It provides tools for querying and interacting with your data, with configurability and permissions enforced by security roles. 

The server maintains control through authenticate, authorization, and risk mitigation features.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Monk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Monk to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://app.monk.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Monk MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Monk provides these MCP tools: get_customer, get_invoice, get_invoice_conversation, list_ar_conversations, list_customer_balances, list_customers, list_invoices, list_organizations, get_customer_by_stripe_id, and get_customer_activity.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Monk?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to Monk in financial-services on the Manufact MCP catalog include Contract-Factory — Sociétés & SIREN, Kavara Kirk, CeylonCharts, Netzo, and Ramp Data.
Monk requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.
Monk is developed by Monk. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
